titleEn: Turn on / off two-step verification (authenticator app)

ar: MFA بيطلب كود وانا مش معايا
en: How do I enable two-step verification?

steps: Account > Security > Enable authenticator, scan QR, enter the code. Store settings pages require MFA enrolment (requireMfaEnrolled).
edgeCases: Many owner routes (settings, finance, staff, pages) refuse until MFA is enrolled
Lost device: recovery is a staff script (mfa-reset, runbook mfa-recovery) - lockout path
Time drift on phone makes codes fail
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: No self-serve MFA recovery codes (audit gap 22)
assistantNote: deep-link only; step-up must be satisfied by the human
